key_insight: More lesion-focused saliency maps do not necessarily explain a classifier’s decisions more faithfully.
clinical_relevance: For medical imaging AI, better overlap with pathology should not be treated as proof that an explanation reliably reflects model reliance.
method: Compared cross-entropy training with Contrastive Grad-CAM Consistency in three-class brain tumor MRI classification.
Used a single-channel ResNet-50 with five-fold patient-grouped cross-validation.
Evaluated classification accuracy, lesion localization, and perturbation-based faithfulness separately.
evidence_signal: CGC improved Pointing Game from 27.24% to 36.02% and accuracy from 93.63% to 94.87%, but faithfulness was mixed: insertion improved, deletion worsened, and IROF was unchanged.
watch_item: This single case study does not establish generalizability across datasets, architectures, or explanation-regularization methods.
paper_title: Localization Gains from Explanation Regularization Should Not Be Interpreted as Faithfulness Gains.
